articles.title: BBAU to launch revamped website soon
articles.description: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow, will soon launch a new in-house, tech-driven website to help students access academic, admission, examination, research and administrative information more easily. Developed by the Department of Computer Science, the platform is built on a centralized database system aimed at improving organisation, accessibility and transparency across university services. According to officials, the redesigned, mobile-friendly site will offer simpler navigation for programmes, admissions, notices and announcements, enabling students to use smartphones and other devices to find key updates quickly. The website will also include an integrated online complaint, grievance redressal and feedback portal to let students and other stakeholders raise concerns digitally. Key features include a programme navigator and admission portal, dedicated pages for schools, departments and centres, self-managed faculty profiles with individual webpages, ORCID integration, an ERP admin portal and a comprehensive research portal. Separate login credentials will allow faculty and authorised officials to update profiles, publications, projects, patents and achievements, with changes reflected automatically via the centralized database. The system will also support NAAC, NIRF and other reporting needs.

articles.description: The Karnataka government has prohibited the production, storage, distribution and sale of 'analogue paneer' being sold as 'paneer' across the state for a year to safeguard public health, officials said on Saturday. "The Food Safety Division of the Department of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Karnataka, has issued a Government Notification dated August 17, prohibiting the manufacturing, processing, packing, storage, distribution, transportation, wholesale and retail sales, display for sale and supply of Analogue/Non-Dairy Paneer being sold under the name 'Paneer' in the state for a year," the department Commissioner Srinivas K, said in a statement. A product prepared in the form of paneer by wholly or partially replacing milk fat or milk solids with vegetable oil, vegetable fat or other non-dairy ingredients is considered Analogue /Non-Dairy Paneer, officials said.
